name: test_bridge
description: Run tests, parse output, enrich failures with context. actions: run/suggest/discover. Find tests? find_tests.

action.description: run: execute tests; suggest: recommend tests after changes; discover: find available tests

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file.description: For action=suggest/discover: source file path relative to workspace_dir

symbol.description: For action=suggest: narrow to a specific symbol
